The company offers an extensive range of hand tools, including spanners, pliers, screwdrivers, cutters, wrenches, hammers, Allen keys, socketry, and comprehensive tool kits, cabinets, and trolleys.

FISCHER.NS.d: Fischer Medical Ventures Limited supplies medical equipment worldwide, covering manufacturing, distribution, leasing and maintenance. Based in Chennai and founded in 1993, its products include MRI and CT scanners, handheld x-ray units for cancer and tuberculosis screening, contactless screening, health kiosks, software and plant-derived nutraceuticals.

FROG.NS.d: Frog Innovations Ltd. is a company that specializes in the production of telecommunications infrastructure hardware. Their comprehensive product line features multi-band digital radio frequency (RF) repeaters compatible with 2G, 3G, and 4G networks, alongside multi-band frequency shifting repeaters and multi-band optical distributed antenna systems (DAS). The company also supplies ancillary software and various accessories to complement these systems.

GAYAHWS.NS.d: Gayatri Highways Limited engages in the construction, operation, and maintenance of roads, highways, vehicle bridges and tunnels, and toll roads in India. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

GODIGIT.NS.d: Go Digit General Insurance Limited provides insurance in India. Its products include motor cover for cars, bikes, rickshaws, taxis and trucks, health plans such as OPD, super top-up and employee health policies, and business covers such as marine cargo, contractors all risk, erection all risk and D&O.

IMPAL.NS.d: India Motor Parts & Accessories Limited, together with its subsidiary, sells and distributes automobile spare parts and accessories in India. It primarily offers engine group components; brake parts, fluid, and systems; steering parts and linkages; and hex, sockets, fasteners, radiators, suspensions, axles, auto electricals, wheels, instrument clusters, etc. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Chennai, India.

IPRINGLTD.NS.d: IP Rings Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker IPRINGLTD and traded in INR. Its country is India.

IVALUE.NS.d: Ivalue Infosolutions Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker IVALUE and traded in INR. Its country is India.

JAYSREETEA.NS.d: Jay Shree Tea & Industries Limited manufactures and sells tea in India and internationally. It operates through Tea, Chemical & Fertilizer, and Sugar segments. It has 21 tea estates in India. The company also manufactures and markets sugar; and chemicals and fertilizers comprising single super phosphate, sulphuric acid, and oleum. In addition, it offers warehousing services, as well as engages in the investment and non-banking financial activities.

JINDWORLD.NS.d: Jindal Worldwide Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, sells, and exports textile products in India and internationally. The company offers denim products, bottom weight fabrics, shirting fabrics, yarn dyed fabrics, specialized fabrics, and technical fabrics and intermediates. It also provides bed sheets, such as quilt covers/duvet covers, flat and fitted sheets, pillow covers, valance sheets, and bloster cases. Jindal Worldwide Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

JSLL.NS.d: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker JSLL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

KIOCL.NS.d: KIOCL Limited manufactures and sells iron oxide pellets for steel plants in India. The company operates in two segments, Pellet and Pig Iron. It produces and sells iron ore pellets; and pig iron. The company also exports its products. KIOCL Limited was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

LAMBODHARA.NS.d: Lambodhara Textiles Limited manufactures and sells synthetic yarns in India and Internationally. The company operates through Textile, Wind Mills, and Real Estate segments. It offers slub yarns, multi count and multi twist yarns, siro yarns, and neppy yarns. The company also exports its products. In addition, it generates electricity through wind. Lambodhara Textiles Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Coimbatore, India.

LICHSGFIN.NS.d: LIC Housing Finance Limited, a housing finance company, provides loans for purchase, construction, repair, and renovation of houses/buildings in India. It offers deposits; home loans to resident and non-resident Indians, as well as before and after retirement loans to pensioners; construction finance and term loans for builders/developers; and loans for staff quarters and other lines of credit for corporates.

LUMAXIND.NS.d: Lumax Industries Limited manufactures, trades in, and supplies auto components for two and three wheelers, four wheelers, commercial vehicles, and tractors/farm equipment in India and internationally. The company offers automotive lamps, including head and tail lamps, LED lamps, and sundry and other auxiliary lamps. It serves automotive original equipment manufacturers. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Gurugram, India.

MANCREDIT.NS.d: Mangal Credit and Fincorp Limited, headquartered in Mumbai, is an Indian non-banking financial company founded in 1961. It traded as Tak Machinery & Leasing Limited until June 2013, and offers loans to small and medium-sized enterprises, personal credit, gold loans and loans against property.

MITCON-SM.NS.d: MITCON CONSU & ENG is an Indian consulting and engineering company. They provide services in areas such as infrastructure development, energy efficiency, and environmental management. MITCON CONSU & ENG is located in Pune, India.

MOLDTECH.NS.d: Mold-Tek Technologies Limited provides civil, structural, and mechanical engineering services in India, the United States, and internationally. It offers mechanical engineering services in the automotive, poles and towers, and oil and gas domains. The company also provides information technology services. Mold-Tek Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

MUKESHB.NS.d: Mukesh Babu Financial Services Limited is an Indian non-banking financial company (NBFC) that provides financial services, including loans and investment products. The company operates primarily in India, offering financial solutions to individuals and small businesses.

NATIONSTD.NS.d: National Standard (India) Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of automotive tyre bead wire. The company supplies its products to tyre manufacturers. National Standard is based in India.

NAVKARCORP.NS.d: Navkar Corporation Limited provides container freight station, inland container depot, and other related services in India. The company operates a private railway freight terminal, which loads and unloads cargo/containers; and owns and operates trailers for the transportation of cargo.

OMAXE.NS.d: Omaxe Limited operates as a real estate development company in India. It develops and sells integrated and hi-tech townships, group housing projects, office spaces, shopping malls, shops, SCOs, hotel projects, and serviced and studio apartments. The company was formerly known as Omaxe Construction Limited and changed its name to Omaxe Limited in June 2006. Omaxe Limited was founded in 1987 and is based in New Delhi, India. Omaxe Limited is a subsidiary of Guild Builders Private Limited.

PARASPETRO.NS.d: Paras Petrofils Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker PARASPETRO and traded in INR. Its country is India.

PRAENG.NS.d: Prajay Engineers Syndicate Limited, a real estate company, engages in the construction and development of residential, commercial, hospitality, and retail properties in India. It operates through Real Estate, and Hotels and Resorts segments. The Real Estate segment is involved in the development, sale, management, and operation of town ships and housing projects, which includes leasing of self owned commercial premises. The Hotels and Resorts segment maintains hotels, restaurants, and resorts.

PVP.NS.d: PVP Ventures Limited and its subsidiaries develop urban infrastructure in India, reporting in Real Estate, Health Care Services and Others segments, and also provide health care services. Incorporated in 1991 and based in Hyderabad, it is a subsidiary of Platex Limited.

RAMKY.NS.d: Ramky Infrastructure Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated construction, infrastructure development, and management services primarily in India. It operates through Construction Business, Developer Business, and Others segments.

RUBFILA.NS.d: Rubfila International Limited makes and supplies rubber threads worldwide from Palakkad, where it has been based since its 1993 start. It has a heat-resistant latex rubber thread division and a corrugated carton box division. Its threads, including talc-coated, silicone-coated and colored types, serve medical devices, food packaging and catheters, and it exports to about 30 countries.

SAMPANN.NS.d: Sampann Utpadan India Limited, set up in 2010, with its head office in Vadodara, makes and distributes reclaimed rubber in India. It has Reclaimed Rubber and Non-Conventional Energy divisions, the latter generating electricity from wind and solar, and its products include butyl, whole tyre and crumb reclaim rubber.

SANDHAR.NS.d: Sandhar Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, assembles, and sells automotive components in India and Europe. It offers locking systems, hinges and latches, and door handles, as well as vision systems; sheet metal components; zinc, aluminum, and magnesium die casting products; plastic injection moulded components; and commercial tooling products, such as plastic molds, and zinc and aluminum PDC dies, as well as painting, plating, and coating solutions.

SONA.NS.d: Sonaselection India Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SONA and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SPORTKING.NS.d: Sportking India Limited is a textile company founded in Ludhiana in 1977. It makes and sells cotton, synthetic and blended yarns mainly within India, and also supplies knitted fabrics. Its apparel division produces a broad range of clothing for men, boys, women and girls, including t-shirts, sweaters, jackets, jeans and sleepwear.

SRHHYPOLTD.NS.d: Sree Rayalaseema Hi-Strength Hypo Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of chemicals in India. The company operates in two segments, Chemical Manufacturing and Power generation. It offers chloramine, purichlor, oleum, sodium dichloroisocyanurate, hydrogen gas, aluminum sulphate, stable bleaching powder, sodium hydride, sodium methoxide powder, sodium methoxide solution, calcium hypochlorite, and water treatment chemicals; and sulphuric, chloro sulphonic, hydrochloric, and monochloro acetic acids.

TIMETECHNO.NS.d: Time Technoplast Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets a range of technology based polymer products in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Polymer and Composite.

TMPV.NS.d: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited is an automaker that handles vehicles from concept and engineering through manufacturing and distribution. It sells passenger cars, SUVs and a growing electric vehicle range, with spare parts and accessories. Its industrial arm makes engines and factory automation equipment, and it also offers IT and other services.

UJJIVANSFB.NS.d: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Limited provides various banking products and services in India. The company operates through Treasury, Retail Banking, and Corporate/Wholesale Banking segments. It offers current, savings, salary, and NRI accounts; and fixed, recurring, TASC fixed, and tax saver fixed deposits.

UNIINFO.NS.d: Uniinfo Telecom Services Limited, set up in 2010 and based in Indore, India, supports telecom equipment makers and operators nationwide. Its services include wireless network planning and design, infrastructure installation, performance testing and optimization, indoor wireless coverage, outsourced operations, IoT deployments and Open RAN integration.
